items.take: Treasury's tentative Q3 2026 auction schedule shows the 3-year note auction on Monday, Nov. 9, the 10-year note reopening on Tuesday, Nov. 10 and the 30-year bond on Thursday, Nov. 12, all announced Wednesday, Nov. 4 and settling Monday, Nov. 16. The 20-year bond follows on Nov. 18 and the 10-year TIPS reopening on Nov. 19. Offering sizes are not given in the schedule and come with the Nov. 4 announcements.

items.headline: L3Harris Q3 revenue $6,060M vs $5,659M; GAAP diluted EPS $3.28 vs $2.46
items.take: L3Harris reported Q3 2026 revenue of $6,060 million versus $5,659 million and diluted EPS of $3.28 versus $2.46. Operating income margin was 13.0% versus 11.0%. Space & Mission Systems revenue was $3,093 million versus $2,803 million.

items.headline: L3Harris raises 2026 GAAP EPS guide to $12.25-$12.35; FCF view $3.0B unchanged
items.take: L3Harris now sees 2026 revenue of $23.5 billion to $23.7 billion (previously $23.2 billion to $23.7 billion) and GAAP EPS of $12.25 to $12.35 (previously $11.80 to $12.00). Free cash flow guidance is unchanged at $3.0 billion. Q3 share repurchases were $73 million versus $176 million a year earlier.

items.headline: TriNet Q3 revenue $1,175M vs $1,232M; diluted EPS $0.65 vs $0.70
items.take: TriNet reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $1,175 million versus $1,232 million and net income of $31 million. Adjusted diluted EPS was $0.94 versus $1.11.

items.headline: TriNet reaffirms 2026 guidance, expects high end of diluted EPS range
items.take: TriNet reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance, including total revenues of $4,750 million to $4,900 million and diluted EPS of $2.85 to $3.35, and said it expects to be at the high end of the EPS range. Adjusted diluted EPS guidance is $4.50 to $5.10.

items.headline: BEA: Q3 real GDP up 3.4% annual rate; core PCE prices up 2.5%
items.take: BEA's advance estimate shows real GDP increased at an annual rate of 3.4% in Q3 2026, versus 2.2% in Q2. The PCE price index rose 2.1% (Q2: 5.0%) and the index excluding food and energy rose 2.5% (Q2: 3.3%). Real final sales to private domestic purchasers rose 4.9%, so growth was not driven by trade or inventories alone; the estimate will be revised on Nov. 25.

items.headline: Oshkosh Q3 net sales $2,841.6M vs $2,688.6M; diluted EPS $2.22 vs $3.04
items.take: Oshkosh reported Q3 2026 net sales of $2,841.6 million, up 5.7% from $2,688.6 million, while GAAP operating income fell 24.3% to $197.1 million. Adjusted diluted EPS was $2.41 versus $3.20. Sales growth did not carry through to profit this quarter.

items.headline: Oshkosh cuts 2026 adjusted EPS outlook to $8.50-$9.50; sales view ~$11.0B
items.take: Oshkosh now expects 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $8.50 to $9.50, down $1.50 to $2.50 from prior guidance, and net sales of about $11.0 billion, down $0.2 billion. GAAP diluted EPS is guided to $8.00-$9.00. The low end includes a possible impact of up to $0.50 per share if no NGDV order is received in 2026.

items.headline: Graham Holdings Q3 revenue $1,326.0M vs $1,278.9M; operating income $85.5M
items.take: Graham Holdings reported Q3 2026 operating revenues of $1,326.0 million, up 4% from $1,278.9 million, and operating income of $85.5 million versus $67.1 million. Diluted EPS was $17.60 versus $27.91; adjusted diluted EPS was $18.77 versus $14.08. The gap between GAAP and adjusted per-share results is the item to read in the reconciliation.

items.headline: Graham Holdings repurchased 176,529 Class B shares for $198.6M in 9M 2026
items.take: In the first nine months of 2026 Graham Holdings bought 176,529 Class B shares at a cost of $198.6 million, with authorization remaining for 285,953 shares as of Sept. 30, 2026. That is a sizable use of cash relative to quarterly operating income of $85.5 million.

items.headline: TPG: $15B raised in Q3, ~$42B YTD; dry powder a record $86B; $0.55 dividend
items.take: TPG said it raised $15 billion in the third quarter and nearly $42 billion year-to-date, and cited record dry powder of $86 billion. Its board declared a $0.55 per share Class A dividend, payable Nov. 23, 2026 to holders of record Nov. 9. Fundraising pace is the key driver of future fee streams for alternative asset managers.

items.headline: HII Q3 revenue $3,537M vs $3,192M; diluted EPS $5.48 vs $3.68
items.take: HII reported Q3 2026 revenues of $3,537 million versus $3,192 million a year earlier (10.8% higher), with net earnings of $217 million versus $145 million and diluted EPS of $5.48 versus $3.68. Free cash flow was $429 million versus $16 million. The jump in cash conversion is the notable change from a year ago.

items.headline: HII raises 2026 shipbuilding revenue guide to $10.5B-$10.7B; FCF guide held
items.take: HII raised its 2026 Shipbuilding revenue guidance to between $10.5 billion and $10.7 billion from $10.2-$10.4 billion, and reaffirmed free cash flow of $500-$600 million. Q3 contract awards were $32.4 billion. Larger awards typically feed future revenue, though timing depends on program execution.

items.headline: CCC Q3 revenue $294.1M vs $267.1M; adjusted EBITDA $130.5M
items.take: CCC Intelligent Solutions reported Q3 2026 revenue of $294.1 million versus $267.1 million (10.1% higher), net income of $30.2 million versus a $2.0 million net loss, and adjusted EBITDA of $130.5 million versus $110.1 million. The company said it is suspending guidance because of its proposed transaction with GTCR and Elliott.

items.headline: Ligand Q3 revenue $78.7M vs $115.5M; raises 2026 adjusted EPS guide to $9.50-$9.75
items.take: Ligand reported Q3 2026 total revenues and income of $78.7 million versus $115.5 million, a GAAP net loss of $28.5 million ($1.43 per share), and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.67 versus $3.09. The prior-year figure included $53.1 million of Pelthos divestiture-related income, which explains much of the revenue gap. It raised 2026 adjusted EPS guidance to about $9.50-$9.75 from $9.00-$9.50.

items.headline: Perella Weinberg Q3 revenue $251.4M vs $164.6M; GAAP EPS $0.21 vs $0.08
items.take: Perella Weinberg reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $251.4 million versus $164.6 million (52.7% higher), with GAAP diluted EPS of $0.21 versus $0.08 and adjusted EPS of $0.39 versus $0.13. It declared a quarterly dividend of $0.07 per share, payable December 8, 2026.

items.headline: Caterpillar Q3 sales and revenues $20.682B vs $17.638B; profit per share $7.13
items.take: Caterpillar reported Q3 2026 total sales and revenues of $20.682 billion versus $17.638 billion, and operating profit of $4.214 billion versus $3.052 billion. Profit per share was $7.13 versus $4.88; adjusted profit per share was $7.20 versus $4.95. Operating margin rose to 20.4% from 17.3%.
items.source_name: Caterpillar Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Caterpillar spent $1.2B on share repurchases and $0.7B on dividends in Q3
items.take: Caterpillar's release shows $1.2 billion of cash used to repurchase common stock in Q3 and $0.7 billion for dividends, with nine-month repurchase payments of $7.745 billion. The release gives no numeric outlook, though the company said it will discuss adjusted profit per share for Q4 and full-year 2026.
items.source_name: Caterpillar Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Cognizant Q3 revenue $5,664M vs $5,415M; GAAP diluted EPS $1.39 vs $0.56
items.take: Cognizant reported Q3 2026 revenue of $5,664 million, up 4.6% from $5,415 million. GAAP diluted EPS was $1.39 versus $0.56, and the prior-year figure included a non-cash income tax charge that reduced EPS by $0.80. Adjusted diluted EPS was $1.49 versus $1.39.
items.source_name: Cognizant Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Cognizant sets 2026 revenue guide at $22.05B-$22.14B; adjusted EPS $5.72-$5.79
items.take: Cognizant guides full-year 2026 revenue to $22.05 billion-$22.14 billion, or growth of 4.5% to 4.9%, with adjusted operating margin of about 16.1% and adjusted diluted EPS of $5.72-$5.79. It repurchased 4.9 million shares for $258 million in Q3, with $2.08 billion left under its authorization.
items.source_name: Cognizant Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Incyte Q3 revenue $1,557.2M vs $1,366.0M; GAAP loss of $3.86 per share
items.take: Incyte reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $1,557.2 million versus $1,366.0 million, with Jakafi/Jakafi XR net sales of $826.5 million versus $791.1 million. GAAP diluted EPS was $(3.86) versus $2.11; the company ties the swing to a one-time $1.23 billion IPR&D expense from its Vega Therapeutics acquisition.
items.source_name: Incyte Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Incyte raises 2026 total net sales guide to $5,210M-$5,300M
items.take: Incyte raised 2026 total net sales guidance to $5,210 million-$5,300 million from $5,130 million-$5,260 million, and Opzelura guidance to $1,100 million-$1,120 million from $1,050 million-$1,100 million. The Opzelura range includes a one-time $246 million benefit from its CMS agreement.
items.source_name: Incyte Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: First Mid Bancshares agrees to acquire Evergreen Bancshares for about $70.7M
items.take: First Mid Bancshares agreed to acquire Evergreen Bancshares, parent of American Bank of Freedom, for about $70.7 million, with each Evergreen share receiving 0.4081 First Mid shares plus $5.20 in cash. Evergreen had about $932 million in total assets and $727 million in deposits at Sept. 30, 2026. Closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027.

items.headline: Kimco raises 2026 FFO guide to $1.84-$1.86 per share; dividend $0.28
items.take: Kimco raised 2026 FFO guidance to $1.84-$1.86 per diluted share from $1.83-$1.84, and net income guidance to $1.07-$1.09 per diluted share from $1.00-$1.03. It declared a quarterly dividend of $0.28 per share, payable Dec. 18 to holders of record Dec. 4. The EPS guidance change reflects the property sale gains the company cited for Q3.

items.headline: Kimco Q3 revenue $546.1M vs $535.9M; FFO $0.47 vs $0.44 per diluted share
items.take: Kimco reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $546.1 million versus $535.9 million, net income of $0.41 per diluted share versus $0.19, and FFO of $0.47 per diluted share versus $0.44. The company said the EPS increase was mainly due to $122.4 million more in gains on property sales, net of impairments. Pro-rata leased occupancy was a record 96.6%.

items.headline: LKQ Q3 revenue $3,319M vs $3,499M; adjusted diluted EPS $0.50 vs $0.84
items.take: LKQ reported Q3 2026 revenue of $3,319 million versus $3,499 million, down 5.1%, with diluted EPS from continuing operations of ($0.09) versus $0.69 and adjusted diluted EPS of $0.50 versus $0.84. Operating cash flow was $411 million and free cash flow $372 million. LKQ had announced on Oct. 23 that it was withdrawing its full-year 2026 guidance, so results arrive without an outlook.

items.headline: XPO repurchased $150M of common stock in Q3; release gives no numeric guidance
items.take: XPO said it repurchased $150 million of common stock in Q3 2026 and is accelerating free cash flow and capital return to shareholders. The release contains no formal financial guidance and no new buyback authorization amount. Capital return without a stated outlook leaves forward expectations to the company's call.

items.headline: XPO Q3 revenue $2,373M vs $2,111M; GAAP diluted EPS $1.53 vs $0.68
items.take: XPO reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2,373 million versus $2,111 million, net income of $181 million versus $82 million, and GAAP diluted EPS of $1.53 versus $0.68. Adjusted EBITDA was $433 million versus $342 million. Earnings grew much faster than revenue, which points to operating leverage rather than volume alone.

items.headline: Fortinet Q3 revenue $2,078.4M vs $1,724.9M; GAAP EPS $0.86 vs $0.62
items.take: Fortinet reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $2,078.4 million versus $1,724.9 million, total billings of $2,336.3 million versus $1,807.7 million, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.86 versus $0.62. GAAP operating margin was 33.9% versus 31.7%. Billings grew faster than revenue, which is the direction that tends to feed later reported revenue.

items.headline: WTW Q3 revenue $2,460M vs $2,288M; diluted EPS $3.24 vs $3.11
items.take: WTW reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2.46 billion versus $2,288 million, with 4% organic growth, net income of $309 million versus $306 million, and diluted EPS of $3.24 versus $3.11. Adjusted diluted EPS was $3.63 versus $3.07. Adjusted EPS grew far faster than GAAP EPS, so the gap between the two measures is the figure to watch.

items.headline: Norwegian Cruise Line Q3 revenue $2,946.8M; diluted EPS $1.07 vs $0.86
items.take: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $2,946.8 million versus $2,938.1 million, net income of $491.5 million versus $419.3 million, and diluted EPS of $1.07 versus $0.86. Adjusted EBITDA was $937 million and adjusted EPS $1.12. Net income rose while revenue was nearly flat, and Net Yield decreased 6.5% as reported (6.7% in constant currency).
items.source_name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Q3 2026 earnings release (GlobeNewswire)

items.headline: FTAI Aviation Q3 revenue $977.7M vs $667.1M; diluted EPS $1.43 vs $1.10
items.take: FTAI Aviation reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $977.7 million versus $667.1 million, net income attributable to shareholders of $149.1 million versus $114.0 million, and diluted EPS of $1.43 versus $1.10. Adjusted EBITDA was $348.3 million versus $297.4 million. Revenue rose about 46.6% by our calculation, outpacing the 30.0% rise in diluted EPS.

items.headline: Norwegian Cruise sets 2026 adjusted EBITDA near $2.55B, Q4 adjusted EPS near ($0.12)
items.take: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings updated 2026 guidance to adjusted EBITDA of approximately $2.55 billion and adjusted EPS of approximately $1.70. For Q4 2026 it guided to adjusted EBITDA of approximately $414 million and adjusted EPS of approximately ($0.12). The guided Q4 adjusted loss per share sits against a Q3 adjusted profit of $1.12, a seasonal swing worth tracking.
items.source_name: Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Q3 2026 earnings release (GlobeNewswire)

items.headline: FTAI Aviation plans $500M accelerated share repurchase with Royal Bank of Canada
items.take: FTAI Aviation said its board approved a $500.0 million increase on Oct. 27, bringing the total repurchase authorization to $1.0 billion, and that it intends to enter an accelerated share repurchase with Royal Bank of Canada for $500.0 million. The company expects to complete the transaction in Q4 2026. It has repurchased about $80.0 million of shares to date, including $50.0 million in Q3.

items.headline: WTW repurchased 687,386 shares for $220M in Q3; expects 2026 buybacks above $1.0B
items.take: WTW said it repurchased 687,386 shares for $220 million in the third quarter. Its 2026 outlook calls for share repurchases to exceed $1.0 billion, subject to market conditions, and organic revenue growth in the mid-single digits. The release also cites a foreign currency tailwind of about $0.35 to full-year adjusted diluted EPS at current rates.

items.headline: Fiverr Q3 revenue $90.9M vs $107.9M; raises 2026 guidance ranges
items.take: Fiverr reported Q3 2026 revenue of $90.9 million versus $107.9 million, a decrease of 15.8% year over year, with GAAP net income of $1.3 million versus $5.5 million and GAAP EPS of $0.03 versus $0.15. The release says it raised financial guidance ranges through fiscal year 2026, to FY revenue of $374-$380 million and adjusted EBITDA of $61-$65 million. Revenue is still shrinking, so the raise reflects a lifted range, not growth.

items.headline: Xcel Q3 GAAP EPS $1.52 vs $0.88; revenue $4,172M vs $3,915M
items.take: Xcel Energy reported Q3 2026 GAAP diluted EPS of $1.52 versus $0.88, with net income of $960 million versus $524 million and total operating revenues of $4,172 million versus $3,915 million, up about 6.6%. Ongoing diluted EPS was $1.52 versus $1.24. GAAP earnings roughly matched ongoing earnings this quarter, so the year-over-year gap in reported EPS was larger than the gap on the ongoing measure.
items.source_name: Xcel Energy Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K Ex. 99.01)

items.headline: Xcel narrows 2026 ongoing EPS guide to $4.10-$4.16; sets 2027 at $4.48-$4.62
items.take: Xcel Energy narrowed 2026 ongoing EPS guidance to $4.10-$4.16 from $4.04-$4.16 and initiated 2027 ongoing EPS guidance of $4.48-$4.62. Its base capital plan for 2027 through 2031 totals $70,000 million, financed with $35,810 million of cash from operations, $26,190 million of new debt and $8,000 million of equity issuance. The financing mix shows that about 37% of the base plan ($26,190M of $70,000M) is slated to come from new debt.
items.source_name: Xcel Energy Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC 8-K Ex. 99.01)

items.headline: Shell Q3 adjusted earnings $10.8B; CFFO $21.0B; $5B buyback for next 3 months
items.take: Shell plc reported Q3 2026 adjusted earnings of $10.8 billion versus $9.8 billion in Q2 2026, income attributable to shareholders of $12.1 billion, and cash flow from operations of $21.0 billion versus $21.4 billion in Q2. It announced $5 billion of buybacks for the next three months. Net debt was $39.7 billion versus $41.8 billion in Q2 2026, so the balance sheet improved sequentially while shareholder distributions continued.

items.headline: STMicro Q3 revenue $3,757M vs $3,187M; GAAP EPS $0.31 vs $0.26; Q4 guide $4.15B
items.take: STMicroelectronics reported Q3 2026 net revenues of $3,757 million versus $3,187 million, GAAP gross margin of 37.3% versus 33.2%, operating income of $367 million versus $180 million, and diluted EPS of $0.31 versus $0.26. At the midpoint, its outlook calls for Q4 net revenues of $4.15 billion and gross margin of about 39.0%. Margin expanded 410 basis points year over year, and the midpoint guide implies further sequential growth.

items.headline: Restaurant Brands Q3 revenue $2,525M vs $2,449M; diluted EPS $1.54 vs $0.96
items.take: Restaurant Brands International reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $2,525 million versus $2,449 million, net income from continuing operations of $704 million versus $440 million, and diluted EPS from continuing operations of $1.54 versus $0.96. Consolidated comparable sales were 3.8% versus 4.0%, system-wide sales were $12,972 million versus $12,282 million, and net restaurant growth was 3.0%. Profit rose much faster than revenue, which grew about 3.1%.
items.source_name: Restaurant Brands International Q3 2026 results (company release)

items.headline: Ares Q3 AUM about $691B; fee related earnings $524.2M; dividend $1.35
items.take: Ares Management reported GAAP net income attributable to Ares Management Corporation of $85.3 million ($0.21 per share) for Q3 2026, assets under management of approximately $691 billion at Sept. 30, fee related earnings of $524.2 million, and after-tax realized income of $449.6 million ($1.26 per Class A share). The common dividend is $1.35 per share, payable Dec. 31, 2026. GAAP earnings were far below realized income per share, which is the gap between its two reporting bases.

items.headline: Kemper preliminary Q3 net income about $52M, $0.88/share; combined ratio about 99.2%
items.take: Kemper's preliminary Q3 2026 results show net income of about $52 million, or $0.88 per diluted share, and a Specialty Auto combined ratio of about 99.2% including about $23 million of favorable prior-year reserve development. The underlying combined ratio was about 101.7%. Full Q3 results are due Nov. 9 and the call is Nov. 10, so these figures are preliminary and could change.

items.headline: Parsons Q3 revenue $1,650.5M vs $1,621.7M; diluted EPS $0.51 vs $0.59
items.take: Parsons reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1,650,548 thousand versus $1,621,748 thousand, up about 1.8%, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.51 versus $0.59. Net income attributable to Parsons was $54,153 thousand versus $64,123 thousand, while adjusted EBITDA including noncontrolling interests rose to $167,843 thousand from $158,137 thousand. Revenue growth was low single digit and GAAP EPS fell, so the quarter's improvement showed up in adjusted EBITDA and backlog rather than in reported earnings per share.

items.headline: Parsons backlog reaches $9.36B; narrows 2026 revenue guide to $6.25B-$6.45B
items.take: Parsons' total backlog was $9,362,466 thousand at Sept. 30, 2026 versus $8,832,447 thousand a year earlier, up about 6.0%, and Q3 contract awards were $1,821,196 thousand versus $1,593,009 thousand. The company said it is narrowing and reiterating the mid-point of its fiscal 2026 guidance, now revenue of $6.25 billion to $6.45 billion (prior $6.20 billion to $6.50 billion) and adjusted EBITDA of $510 million to $550 million (prior $500 million to $560 million). Awards running above revenue in the quarter is what lifts backlog, and the narrowed ranges signal tighter visibility on the year rather than a change in the midpoint.

items.headline: Churchill Downs Q3 net revenue $696M vs $683M; diluted EPS $1.15 vs $0.54
items.take: Churchill Downs reported Q3 2026 net revenue of $696 million versus $683 million, net income attributable to CDI of $80 million versus $38 million, and diluted EPS attributable to CDI of $1.15 versus $0.54. Adjusted EBITDA was $264 million versus $262 million. The company's release says the prior-year quarter included a $35 million after-tax impairment of its Chasers gaming rights, so most of the EPS gap reflects that comparison while adjusted EBITDA grew about 1%.

items.headline: ECB Governing Council meets Oct. 28-29; decision and press conference due Thursday
items.take: The ECB's meeting calendar lists the Governing Council's monetary policy meeting on Oct. 28 and 29, 2026, with a press conference following on Day 2, and the next on Dec. 16-17. The ECB says monetary policy decisions are published in a press release at 14:15 CET on the day of the meeting. The Fed held and the Bank of Canada raised this week, so the ECB outcome rounds out the major central-bank decisions for the week.
items.source_name: ECB: Meetings of the Governing Council

items.headline: Bank of Japan meets Oct. 29-30; policy statement due Friday, time not yet set
items.take: The Bank of Japan's release schedule lists a Monetary Policy Meeting on Oct. 29 and 30, 2026, with the Statement on Monetary Policy and the October Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices both scheduled for Oct. 30, times undecided. The Summary of Opinions is scheduled for Nov. 10. The BoJ's most recent policy action was a Sept. 18 change to its guideline for money market operations, so Friday's statement is the first update since then.

items.headline: Treasury's 7-year note auction is set for Thursday, completing the week's coupon sales
items.take: Treasury's tentative auction schedule lists a 7-year note auction on Thursday, Oct. 29, settling Monday, Nov. 2, after the 2-year note on Oct. 26 and the 5-year note on Oct. 27, which also settle Nov. 2; a 2-year floating rate note was set for Oct. 28. The schedule also lists 4-week and 8-week bill auctions on Oct. 29 settling Nov. 3. The schedule does not give offering amounts, which are set in the Treasury's announcement for each auction.

items.headline: Microsoft Q1 FY27 revenue $92,279M vs $77,673M; GAAP diluted EPS $4.92 vs $3.72
items.take: Microsoft reported revenue of $92,279 million for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 versus $77,673 million a year earlier, with operating income of $45,915 million versus $37,961 million. GAAP net income was $36,629 million versus $27,747 million and GAAP diluted EPS was $4.92 versus $3.72. Non-GAAP net income and EPS exclude the impact of OpenAI investments, so the GAAP and non-GAAP growth rates (32% and 18%) differ materially.
items.source_name: Microsoft Q1 FY2027 earnings release (SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: Microsoft Cloud revenue $63.9B, up 30%; Agents and Infra $76.8B, Devices and Consumer $15.5B
items.take: Microsoft said Microsoft Cloud revenue was $63.9 billion, up 30% (31% in constant currency). Under its recast segments, Agents and Infra revenue was $76,795 million versus $61,672 million (up 25%), while Devices and Consumer was $15,484 million versus $16,001 million (down 3%). The release shows nearly all of the company's growth came from the cloud and infrastructure segment.
items.source_name: Microsoft Q1 FY2027 earnings release (SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex. 99.1)

items.headline: MISTRAS go-shop ends with no rival bids; H.I.G. $20.35/share deal vote set Nov. 24
items.take: MISTRAS said its 40-day go-shop expired on October 28 with no alternative acquisition proposals received; its adviser Baird contacted or was contacted by 122 third parties, and 40 signed confidentiality agreements. The all-cash H.I.G. Capital deal is at $20.35 per share, about $866 million enterprise value including debt, with a virtual special stockholder meeting on November 24, 2026. No-shop provisions now apply, subject to a fiduciary out, and closing is expected in late 2026 or early 2027.

items.headline: MYR Group Q3 revenue $1,259.0M vs $950.4M; diluted EPS $3.82 vs $2.05; backlog $3.68B
items.take: MYR Group reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1,259.0 million versus $950.4 million a year earlier, net income of $60.0 million versus $32.1 million, and diluted EPS of $3.82 versus $2.05. Backlog was $3.68 billion at September 30, 2026, up $1.02 billion (38.2%) from a year earlier, split $2.39 billion commercial and industrial and $1.29 billion transmission and distribution. The board also approved a repurchase program of up to $100.0 million effective November 4, 2026.

items.headline: Hudson Technologies Q3 revenue $59.4M vs $74.0M; diluted EPS $0.05 vs $0.27
items.take: Hudson Technologies reported Q3 2026 revenue of $59.4 million versus $74.0 million a year earlier, net income of $2.0 million versus $12.4 million, and diluted EPS of $0.05 versus $0.27. The company expects full-year 2026 gross margin in the low-to-mid-twenty percent range, consistent with its prior target, and gave no revenue or EPS guidance.

items.headline: ServiceNow Q3 revenue $4,106M vs $3,407M; GAAP EPS $0.27 vs $0.48
items.take: ServiceNow reported Q3 2026 total revenues of $4,106 million versus $3,407 million a year earlier, up 20.5%, with subscription revenues of $3,988 million versus $3,299 million. GAAP net income was $277 million versus $502 million, GAAP diluted EPS was $0.27 versus $0.48, and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.00 versus $0.95. Revenue grew faster than 20% while GAAP earnings fell, so the year-over-year decline in GAAP net income is the line to watch.

items.headline: ServiceNow cRPO $13.65B, up 20.5%; Q4 subscription revenue guide $4,245M-$4,255M
items.take: ServiceNow reported current remaining performance obligations of $13.65 billion, up 20.5% year over year (21% in constant currency). It guided Q4 2026 subscription revenues to $4,245 million-$4,255 million, or 22.5% to 23% growth, with Q4 cRPO growth of 18.5%. For full-year 2026 it guides subscription revenues to $15,780 million-$15,790 million, 22.5% growth.

items.headline: Sprouts Q3 net sales $2,304.7M vs $2,200.4M; diluted EPS $1.21 vs $1.22
items.take: Sprouts Farmers Market reported Q3 2026 net sales of $2,304.7 million versus $2,200.4 million, up 4.7%, for the 13 weeks ended September 27, 2026. Comparable store sales were (0.9)%, net income was $113.4 million versus $120.1 million, and diluted EPS was $1.21 versus $1.22. Sales rose on store growth while comparable sales were slightly negative.
items.source_name: Sprouts Farmers Market Q3 2026 release (Business Wire)

items.headline: Sprouts guides Q4 comps (2.0)%-(4.0)%, EPS $0.47-$0.51; 2026 EPS about $4.80
items.take: Sprouts guided Q4 2026 comparable store sales to (2.0)% to (4.0)% and diluted EPS to $0.47-$0.51 on a 13-week basis. Its full-year 52-week outlook calls for net sales growth of about 4.3%, comparable store sales of about (1.7)%, EBIT of about $605 million and diluted EPS of about $4.80. The release estimates the 53rd week adds about $190 million of sales and $0.16 of diluted EPS to Q4.
items.source_name: Sprouts Farmers Market Q3 2026 release (Business Wire)

items.headline: SCI Q3 revenue $1,107.3M vs $1,058.1M; diluted EPS $1.03 vs $0.83
items.take: Service Corporation International reported Q3 2026 revenue of $1,107.3 million versus $1,058.1 million, up 4.6%. Net income attributable to common stockholders was $141.3 million versus $117.5 million; diluted EPS was $1.03, and $0.97 excluding special items versus $0.87. It guided Q4 adjusted diluted EPS to $1.10-$1.20 and full-year adjusted EPS to $3.94-$4.04.
items.source_name: Service Corporation International Q3 2026 release (PR Newswire)

items.headline: Tenable Q3 revenue $276.4M, up 9.5%; GAAP net income $11.3M vs $2.3M
items.take: Tenable reported Q3 2026 revenue of $276,387 thousand versus $252,440 thousand, up 9.5%, with GAAP net income of $11,299 thousand versus $2,260 thousand. GAAP diluted EPS was $0.10 versus $0.02 and non-GAAP diluted EPS was $0.63 versus $0.42. It guided Q4 revenue to $277.0 million-$280.0 million and full-year revenue to $1.084 billion-$1.087 billion.

items.headline: Alphabet Q3 revenue $127,577M vs $102,346M; diluted EPS $2.12 vs $2.87
items.take: Alphabet reported Q3 2026 revenues of $127,577 million versus $102,346 million a year earlier, up 24.7%, and operating income of $40,576 million versus $31,228 million. Net income available to common stockholders was $26,170 million versus $34,979 million, and diluted EPS was $2.12 versus $2.87. Profit fell even as operating income rose, so the gap sits below the operating line.

items.headline: Alphabet: Google Cloud Q3 revenue $30,709M vs $15,157M; release cites 103% growth
items.take: Alphabet's release says Google Cloud revenues increased 103% to $30.7 billion in Q3 2026; the segment table shows $30,709 million versus $15,157 million a year earlier. Alphabet also declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per share, payable December 14, 2026. Cloud now accounts for about 24% of Alphabet revenue, versus about 15% a year ago.

items.headline: O'Reilly Q3 sales $5.12B vs $4.71B; diluted EPS $0.97 vs $0.85; comps up 7.2%
items.take: O'Reilly Automotive reported Q3 2026 sales of $5.12 billion versus $4.71 billion, an increase of $416 million or 9%, with comparable store sales up 7.2% on top of 5.6% a year earlier. Net income was $786 million versus $726 million and diluted EPS was $0.97 versus $0.85. Comparable-store growth outpacing the prior-year comparison points to demand strength rather than easy comps.

items.headline: O'Reilly raises 2026 comp-store sales guide to 5.5%-6.5%; EPS $3.25-$3.35
items.take: O'Reilly raised its full-year 2026 comparable store sales guidance to a range of 5.5% to 6.5%. It guides diluted EPS of $3.25 to $3.35, total revenue of $19.0 billion to $19.3 billion, and 225 to 235 net new store openings. The raised comp range is the guidance item to watch against Q4 results.

items.headline: Meritage Homes Q3 orders 3,083, down 15%; home closing gross margin 17.4% vs 19.1%
items.take: Meritage Homes reported Q3 2026 orders of 3,083 homes, down 15% year over year, and home closing revenue of $1,162.4 million versus $1,399.3 million, a 17% decrease. Net earnings were $68 million ($1.04 per diluted share) versus $1.39 per share a year earlier, and backlog at Sept. 30 was 1,611 homes versus 1,699. A 170 bp gross margin decline alongside fewer orders shows pressure on both volume and pricing for this builder.

items.headline: Amrize Q3 revenue $3,771M vs $3,690M; net income $558M; diluted EPS $1.02
items.take: Amrize reported Q3 2026 revenues of $3,771 million versus $3,690 million, net income of $558 million versus $540 million, and diluted EPS of $1.02 versus $0.98. Adjusted EBITDA was $1,076 million versus $1,074 million. It updated 2026 guidance to revenues of $12.2 billion to $12.4 billion and adjusted EBITDA of $2.95 billion to $3.05 billion, so earnings growth outpaced a flat EBITDA line.

items.headline: Bank of Canada raises overnight rate 25 bp to 2.5%; says further hikes possible
items.take: The Bank of Canada raised its overnight rate target by 25 basis points to 2.5%, with the Bank Rate at 2.75% and the deposit rate at 2.45%. It said CPI has been around 3% since April and is expected near 3½% by year-end, and that there could be a need to raise the policy rate further, though Governing Council agreed to proceed carefully. The move follows the Bank's September hold at 2¼%, and the explicit mention of more tightening makes this an energy-inflation response rather than a one-off.
items.source_name: Bank of Canada: Policy rate announcement, Oct. 28, 2026

items.headline: Pilgrim's Pride Q3 net sales $4,653.2M vs $4,759.3M; GAAP EPS $0.49 vs $1.44
items.take: Pilgrim's Pride reported Q3 2026 net sales of $4,653.2 million versus $4,759.3 million, down 2.2%, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.49 versus $1.44. Adjusted EBITDA was $316.3 million, a 6.8% margin, versus $633.1 million a year earlier. Profit fell far faster than sales, which points to a margin squeeze rather than a volume problem.

items.headline: Ryerson Q3 revenue $2,177.8M vs $1,161.5M; diluted EPS $0.61 vs $(0.46)
items.take: Ryerson reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2,177.8 million versus $1,161.5 million, up 87.5%, and net income attributable to Ryerson of $32.0 million versus a net loss of $14.8 million. Adjusted EBITDA excluding LIFO was $115.0 million versus $40.3 million. For Q4 it guided net sales of $1.96 billion to $2.04 billion, with the release including an expected $28 million to $30 million of adjusted EBITDA from Olympic Steel.

items.headline: MediaAlpha Q3 revenue $375.9M vs $306.5M; net income $29.4M; Q4 revenue guide $355M-$375M
items.take: MediaAlpha reported Q3 2026 revenue of $375.9 million versus $306.5 million, up 22.7%, with net income of $29.4 million versus $17.6 million and adjusted EBITDA of $39.5 million versus $29.1 million. It guided Q4 revenue to $355 million to $375 million and adjusted EBITDA to $36.0 million to $39.0 million. Net income grew 66.4% against revenue growth of 22.7%, which points to operating leverage in the quarter.

items.headline: Employers Holdings Q3 net income $11.6M vs $(8.3)M loss; combined ratio 108.4%
items.take: Employers Holdings reported Q3 2026 net income of $11.6 million, or $0.64 per diluted share, versus a net loss of $8.3 million, or $(0.36), a year earlier. Net premiums earned were $160.2 million versus $192.1 million, and the GAAP combined ratio was 108.4% versus 129.7%. A combined ratio above 100% means underwriting costs and losses exceeded premiums earned, so the quarter's profit came despite an underwriting result still short of break-even.

items.headline: Markel Q3 total operating revenues $4,158.2M vs $3,934.5M; adj. operating income $707.4M
items.take: Markel reported Q3 2026 total operating revenues of $4,158.2 million versus $3,934.5 million, up 5.7%. Operating income was $383.2 million versus $1,009.8 million, while adjusted operating income rose to $707.4 million from $621.0 million. The Markel Insurance segment's combined ratio was 92% versus 93%; the gap between operating and adjusted operating income is worth a read of the full release.

items.headline: Enerpac completes SFE Group acquisition for about $472M
items.take: Enerpac Tool Group said it completed its previously announced acquisition of Specialized Fabrication Equipment Group LLC for a purchase price of approximately $472 million, including approximately $452 million in cash. SFE Group had about $170 million of sales and about $44 million of adjusted EBITDA for the twelve months ended March 31, 2026, implying 10.6x trailing adjusted EBITDA per the release. The deal was financed partly with a new $850 million credit facility, with pro forma net debt to adjusted EBITDA of about 2.3x.

items.headline: FOMC holds target range at 3-3/4 to 4 percent in 10-2 vote; Cook, Hammack dissent
items.take: The Federal Reserve said the FOMC voted 10 to 2 to maintain the federal funds target range at 3-3/4 to 4 percent. Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack dissented, preferring a 1/4 percentage point increase. The statement says inflation remains elevated and that the Committee is maintaining ample reserves in the banking system; two dissents in favor of a hike mark a hawkish tilt within the vote.
items.source_name: Federal Reserve Board: FOMC statement, Oct. 28, 2026

items.headline: Alphabet to post Q3 2026 results today; call set for 4:30 p.m. ET
items.take: Alphabet said it will hold its Q3 2026 financial results conference call on Wednesday, Oct. 28 at 1:30 p.m. Pacific (4:30 p.m. Eastern), with the earnings release posted on its investor relations site before the call. A replay will be available on YouTube after the webcast.

items.headline: Vantiva Q3 revenue €436M vs €470M; maintains positive 2026 free cash flow guide
items.take: Vantiva reported Q3 2026 continuing-operations revenue of €436 million versus €470 million a year earlier, down 7.3% at current rates. Broadband revenue was €321 million versus €378 million, while Video was €115 million versus €92 million. The company maintained its full-year 2026 guidance for positive free cash flow; 2025 comparatives were restated for reclassifications.
items.source_name: Vantiva Q3 and nine-month 2026 sales release (GlobeNewswire)

items.headline: SPIE agrees to buy 76% of Austria's SAR Anlagenbau; closing seen early 2027
items.take: SPIE announced an agreement to acquire a 76% stake in SAR ANLAGENBAU GmbH, based in Hausmening, Austria, with managing director Arno Reisinger holding up to 24%. SAR has about 230 employees and around €100 million of revenue for fiscal 2025/26, and the price was not disclosed. Closing is expected at the beginning of 2027, subject to customary closing conditions.

items.headline: Natural Health Trends Q3 revenue $7.56M vs $9.48M; net loss $0.23M
items.take: Natural Health Trends reported Q3 2026 net sales of $7,560 thousand versus $9,477 thousand a year earlier, a decline of 20.2% by our calculation. Net loss was $(232) thousand, or $(0.03) per diluted share, versus $(431) thousand, or $(0.04). The release reports $1,716 thousand of dividends paid in the first nine months of 2026 and leaves future dividends to the Board's discretion.

items.headline: Stellantis Q3 net revenues €37,611M vs €37,206M; net loss €(453)M vs €(4,532)M
items.take: Stellantis reported Q3 2026 net revenues of €37,611 million versus €37,206 million, adjusted operating income of €256 million versus €90 million, and a net loss of €(453) million versus €(4,532) million. Industrial free cash flow was €(4,009) million versus €(4,304) million. The narrowing loss and a 0.7% AOI margin show the recovery is still thin against heavy cash outflow.

items.headline: Stellantis reaffirms 2026 guidance; expects positive industrial free cash flow in 2027
items.take: Stellantis reaffirmed 2026 guidance of a mid-single-digit percentage increase in net revenues and a low-single-digit AOI margin, with improved industrial free cash flow including about €1.6 billion in cash payments related to H2 2025 charges. It also expects positive industrial free cash flow in 2027. With Q3 industrial free cash flow at €(4.0) billion, the guide leaves the burden on Q4 and 2027.

items.headline: Axogen Q3 revenue $75.8M vs $60.1M; net income $2.3M, EPS $0.04
items.take: Axogen reported Q3 2026 revenue of $75.8 million, up 26.2% from $60.1 million, with GAAP net income of $2.3 million, or $0.04 per share, versus $0.7 million, or $0.01 per share. It expects full-year revenue of at least $290 million, including at least $7 million from the BioCircuit acquisition. Excluding that deal, the guide implies at least $283 million of organic revenue.

items.headline: California BanCorp Q3 net income $14.0M, EPS $0.43; NIM 4.61% vs 4.71% in Q2
items.take: California BanCorp reported Q3 2026 net income of $14.0 million, or $0.43 per diluted share, versus $14.3 million, or $0.44, in Q2 and $15.7 million, or $0.48, in Q3 2025. Net interest margin was 4.61% versus 4.71% in Q2, while total deposits rose $117.4 million to $3.48 billion. Deposit growth outpaced loan growth of $53.3 million, but the margin slipped.

items.headline: Ensign Group Q3 revenue $1,484.0M vs $1,296.4M; raises 2026 EPS guide to $7.94-$8.02
items.take: Ensign Group reported Q3 2026 total revenue of $1,484.0 million versus $1,296.4 million, a 14.5% increase by our calculation, with GAAP diluted EPS of $1.76 versus $1.42 and adjusted diluted EPS of $2.03 versus $1.64. It raised 2026 annual earnings guidance to $7.94-$8.02 per diluted share from $7.75-$7.85. The raise is modest relative to the Q3 beat in adjusted EPS.

items.headline: W. P. Carey Q3 AFFO $1.33/share vs $1.25; raises 2026 AFFO guide to $5.23-$5.29
items.take: W. P. Carey reported Q3 2026 AFFO of $1.33 per diluted share versus $1.25, with diluted EPS of $0.61 versus $0.64 and total revenues of $468.3 million versus $431.3 million. items.headline: Boston Scientific Q3 net sales $5.138B vs $5.065B; GAAP EPS $0.40 vs $0.51
items.take: Boston Scientific reported Q3 2026 net sales of $5.138 billion versus $5.065 billion, up 1.5% on a reported, operational and organic basis, with GAAP EPS of $0.40 versus $0.51 and adjusted EPS of $0.73 versus $0.75. Net sales growth of 1.5% is below the roughly 4.25% reported growth the company now guides for the full year.

items.headline: Boston Scientific guides Q4 net sales down 1%-3%; 2026 adj. EPS $3.16-$3.18
items.take: Boston Scientific expects Q4 2026 net sales to decline approximately 3.0% to 1.0% on both a reported and organic basis, with Q4 adjusted EPS of $0.77 to $0.79. For full-year 2026 it guides net sales growth of approximately 4.25% reported and 3.75% organic, and adjusted EPS of $3.16 to $3.18. A Q4 sales decline guided against 1.5% growth in Q3 marks a step down in the company's own outlook.
